metadata.description: Business Central agentic development tools - skills for AI-assisted AL development

plugins.name: al-build
plugins.description: Build and test AL apps for Business Central. Compiles and runs tests locally using a local Docker container. Includes quality gate hook.

plugins.name: grill-me
plugins.description: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design until reaching shared understanding, resolving each branch of the decision tree. Use when user wants to stress-test a plan, get grilled on their design, or mentions 'grill me'.

plugins.name: bc-standard-reference
plugins.description: Locate canonical Business Central Standard behavior (BaseApp, System Application, APIV2, etc.) for events, codeunits, tables, pages, APIs.

plugins.name: release-notes
plugins.description: Generate release notes from PR analysis.

plugins.name: al-debug-logging
plugins.description: AL Debug Logging — add temporary DEBUG-* FeatureTelemetry probes to AL code to inspect runtime behavior via .output/TestResults/telemetry.jsonl.

plugins.name: al-agentic-dev
plugins.description: Agentic AL/Business Central development: composable skills (al-steer, al-grill-adr, al-design, al-scope, al-refine, al-implement, al-refactor, al-mutate, al-research) with persistent repo-root memory (CONTEXT.md, docs/adr/, .out-of-scope/) and branch-scoped feature state (architecture.md + tasks.md).
